_comment: bonus-loot (playtest 6): PvP uniques. Completed, mid-value items the shop NEVER sells (purchasable false); they drop only from a Mid-tier Bonus Loot Stage (LootTables.json bonusStage). Each entry uses the Items.json item schema (stats follow the universal-scaling policy: primary stat + flat HP/mana/armor/ward) plus a `pvp` block whose effect works ONLY against enemy champions (arena PvP). pvp.kind: championDamage (+amount % damage to champions) | championGuard (-amount % damage from champions) | mortalWounds (healing received -amount % for duration s) | silenceStrike (first hit every cooldown s silences for duration s) | execute (+amount % damage below threshold % health) | spellbreaker (first champion spell every cooldown s -amount %) | lastStand (below threshold % health: barrier of amount % max HP for duration s, cooldown s) | vengeance (reflect amount % of champion damage) | frostbite (hits slow for duration s, once per cooldown s per target) | pursuit (+amount % move speed for duration s after hitting a champion). Loaded with Items.json (restart or an Items reload picks up edits). Docs/Items.md.

items.name: Gladiator's Crest
items.lore: Struck for the champions of the sand pits; it hungers only for worthy foes.

items.name: Colosseum Bulwark
items.effect: PvP: take 12% less damage from enemy champions.
items.lore: Every dent is a duel it won.

items.name: Grievous Thorn
items.effect: PvP: your hits on champions cut their healing received by 40% for 3 s.
items.lore: The barb stays in the wound; no mending takes.

items.name: Hushblade Signet
items.effect: PvP: your first hit on a champion every 15 s silences it for 1 s.
items.lore: Worn by the court's quiet knives. The first cut steals the voice.

items.name: Headhunter's Mark
items.effect: PvP: +20% damage to champions below 35% health.
items.lore: A trophy-taker's brand. It glows when prey falters.

items.name: Spellbreaker Veil
items.effect: PvP: the first champion ability that hits you every 20 s deals 60% less damage.
items.lore: Woven from a silenced archmage's mantle.

items.name: Talisman of the Last Stand
items.effect: PvP: when a champion drops you below 30% health, gain a barrier of 25% max health for 4 s (60 s cooldown).
items.lore: It wakes only when you are about to fall.

items.name: Vengeance Sigil
items.effect: PvP: reflect 15% of the damage enemy champions deal to you back at them.
items.lore: What is done to the bearer is done again.

items.name: Rimebrand
items.effect: PvP: your hits slow an enemy champion for 1.5 s (once every 4 s per target).
items.lore: Cold iron from the north pass. It bites the legs first.

items.name: Hunter's Pursuit
items.effect: PvP: damaging an enemy champion grants +15% move speed for 2 s.
items.lore: The chase is half the kill.
